```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.retina = 2
)

library(flexdashboard)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(leaflet)
library(DT)
library(sf)
library(scales)

data_path <- "data/processed/pa_diabetes_mortality_age_adjusted_2018_2025.csv"
state_path <- "data/processed/pa_diabetes_state_trend_2018_2025.csv"
shape_path <- "data/processed/pa_counties.rds"

required_files <- c(data_path, state_path, shape_path)
if (!all(file.exists(required_files))) {
  stop("Required data are missing. Run source('scripts/fetch_data.R') first.")
}

dat <- read.csv(data_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dat$county_fips <- sprintf("%05s", dat$county_fips)
state_trend <- read.csv(state_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

pa_map <- readRDS(shape_path) |>
  st_transform(4326)
pa_map$county_fips <- as.character(pa_map$county_fips)

# Map: one row per county for the most recent year.
map_year <- max(dat$year)
by_county <- dat |>
  filter(.data$year == map_year) |>
  select(
    .data$county_fips, .data$county_name, .data$deaths,
    .data$expected_annual_age, .data$age_adjusted_smr,
    .data$age_adjusted_smr_low, .data$age_adjusted_smr_high
  )

my_map <- pa_map |>
  left_join(by_county, by = c("county_fips", "county_name"))

join_missing <- sum(is.na(my_map$age_adjusted_smr))
stopifnot(join_missing == 0L, nrow(by_county) == 67L)

# Time series: Pennsylvania and one county with sufficiently large counts.
focus <- "Allegheny"
by_year <- bind_rows(
  state_trend |>
    transmute(
      year = .data$year,
      SMR = .data$fixed_reference_smr,
      area = "Pennsylvania"
    ),
  dat |>
    filter(.data$county_name == focus) |>
    transmute(
      year = .data$year,
      SMR = .data$fixed_reference_smr,
      area = paste0(focus, " County")
    )
)
```

Column {data-width=600}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Age-adjusted diabetes mortality ratio by Pennsylvania county, 2025

```{r map}
breaks <- c(0, 0.50, 2 / 3, 0.90, 1 / 0.90, 1.50, 2, Inf)
pal <- colorBin(
  rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(7, "RdBu")),
  domain = my_map$age_adjusted_smr,
  bins = breaks,
  na.color = "#d9d9d9"
)

map_labels <- sprintf(
  paste0(
    "<strong>%s County</strong><br/>",
    "Age-adjusted SMR: %.2f<br/>",
    "Observed deaths: %s<br/>",
    "Age-adjusted expected deaths: %.1f<br/>",
    "Exact 95%% CI: %.2f-%.2f"
  ),
  my_map$county_name,
  my_map$age_adjusted_smr,
  comma(my_map$deaths),
  my_map$expected_annual_age,
  my_map$age_adjusted_smr_low,
  my_map$age_adjusted_smr_high
) |>
  lapply(htmltools::HTML)

leaflet(
  my_map,
  options = leafletOptions(
    minZoom = 6,
    maxZoom = 9,
    attributionControl = FALSE
  )
) |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal(age_adjusted_smr),
    fillOpacity = 0.86,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1,
    label = map_labels,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 3,
      color = "#17324d",
      bringToFront = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = ~age_adjusted_smr,
    title = "Age-adjusted SMR",
    labFormat = labelFormat(digits = 2),
    opacity = 0.9
  ) |>
  fitBounds(-80.6, 39.6, -74.5, 42.6)
```

> SMR = observed / age-adjusted expected deaths. Red counties have more deaths than expected; blue counties have fewer. The Pennsylvania annual reference is 1.

Column {data-width=400}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Fixed-reference SMR by year: Pennsylvania and Allegheny County

```{r time-series}
cols <- setNames(
  c("#111111", "#b2182b"),
  c("Pennsylvania", paste0(focus, " County"))
)

p <- ggplot(
  by_year,
  aes(
    x = .data$year,
    y = .data$SMR,
    colour = .data$area,
    group = .data$area,
    text = sprintf(
      "%s<br/>Year: %s<br/>Fixed-reference SMR: %.2f",
      .data$area,
      .data$year,
      .data$SMR
    )
  )
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2018:2025) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Fixed-reference SMR",
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
```

> Pennsylvania mortality peaked in 2020 and then declined below the 2018-2019 reference by 2023. Allegheny County followed a similar pattern and remained below the statewide reference in 2025.

### About these data

- **Outcome:** underlying-cause diabetes deaths, 2018-2025, by year.
- **Population at risk:** residents of all 67 Pennsylvania counties.
- **Expected counts:** indirect standardization using five age groups (0-44, 45-64, 65-74, 75-84, and 85+).
- **Map measure:** annual age-adjusted SMR for 2025; the Pennsylvania annual reference equals 1.
- **Time-series measure:** SMR against fixed pooled Pennsylvania 2018-2019 age-specific rates.
- **Sources:** [PA Department of Health death statistics, 2018-2024](https://www.pa.gov/agencies/health/health-statistics/birth-death-and-other-vital-statistics/death-statistics); [PA 2025 county-age-cause archive](https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/health/documents/topics/healthstatistics/vitalstatistics/deathstatistics/documents/2025/data-zipped/county-age-cause-2025.zip); [Census county-age populations](https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/popest/datasets/2020-2025/counties/asrh/cc-est2025-agesex-42.csv); [Census county boundaries](https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/GENZ2022/shp/cb_2022_us_county_500k.zip).
- **Areas without data:** none; the polygon-data join check returned `r join_missing` missing counties.
- **Limitation:** mortality measures fatal disease burden, not everyone living with diabetes; five broad age groups may leave residual age differences.

> The repository includes `data/processed/data_sources.csv`, which identifies the observed-death, population, and boundary files. These are aggregated county-year counts, not individual records.
